summary: The pixel-art visuals consistently follow the pixel8 aesthetic with readable characters and thematic props. Prop interactions like mate holding and character framing are clear, though hand positioning remains basic.

clean: Character appearances follow style guidelines with light skin and uniform floating hands.
Hero mate object features proper glow halo effect in shot 8.
unclean: shot 5: Stirring action described in narration is shown as a static hold rather than dynamic motion.
shot 11: Hand placement relative to the passed mate appears slightly detached.

clean: Pixelify Sans typography remains legible and positioned correctly at top.
Color palette and background elements maintain scene continuity.
unclean: shot 6: Gourd holding visually clips into character body edge.

issues.problem: Stirring action is not visually depicted.
issues.fix: Add small pixel motion lines around bombilla to indicate stirring motion.

issues.problem: Mate gourd clips slightly into body torso layer.
issues.fix: Adjust X offset of the held mate object forward.

learnings.rule: Use dedicated motion indicator frames for active object manipulation.
Avoid overlapping held hero objects directly on body centerlines without offset.
